meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 啰嗦的回复压成简短回答，省下输出开销还保住技术要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 AI 回答总是长篇大论，你只想看要点。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink AI replies into short answers while keeping the technical points intact.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if AI answers ramble on and you just want the key points.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 默认改用极简的「caveman」风格回答:去掉冠词、填充词和客套话,只留技术要点,代码块和报错原文不动。有 lite、full、ultra 和文言文各档,默认 full。
howto.when: 当你说出 /caveman、「caveman mode」等关键词时触发。装好后整个会话默认一直是这个风格,直到你要求停止(如说「normal mode」)。

say.note: 切到最压缩档,一句一事实

say.text: 用 caveman 风格讲下数据库连接池
say.note: 回答变短,代码保持原样

howto.what_en: After install, Claude answers in a terse caveman style by default: articles, filler and pleasantries go, technical substance and code stay unchanged. Levels: lite, full, ultra and wenyan variants; default is full.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman or phrases like "caveman mode". Once on, it stays the session default until you say "stop caveman" or "normal mode".

say_en.text: Switch to /caveman ultra for this answer.
say_en.note: Most compressed level; one fact per line.

say_en.text: Explain database connection pooling in caveman style.
